turns.content: State the de Broglie relation for an electron and identify the momentum needed when its speed is 1.00% of the speed of light.
Estimate v/c and the Lorentz factor, then decide whether the nonrelativistic momentum is adequate at this speed.
Convert 1.00% of the speed of light to metres per second.
Using the electron mass, calculate the momentum with the justified approximation.
Use Wien's displacement law with the electron momentum calculated above to determine the wavelength.
Convert the wavelength to picometres and state how it scales with speed in the nonrelativistic limit.
Estimate the size of the relativistic correction and explain the appropriate precision of the result.
Check the dimensions and order of magnitude independently.
Report the muon lifetime at 1.00% of light speed and predict it at twice that speed.
